long_biography.plain_text:
To win oil-company charters for his first tanker, Peter C. Georgiopoulos enlisted established Universe Tankships as manager and recruited experienced executives. That team gave the new General Maritime the operating record needed to secure business from major energy companies.

Georgiopoulos paired shipping judgement with capital-markets training from Drexel Burnham Lambert. He bought discounted interests in distressed Norwegian shipping funds through Maritime Equity Management, then carried that transaction discipline into tanker acquisitions and public listings. At United Overseas Group, he remains an active owner, rebuilding exposure to chemical, product and crude tankers while expanding into dry bulk. He also chairs a separate acquisition company, keeping public-market dealmaking alongside commercial shipping.
